deal_name: Nordbyte Logistics — AI SDR Risk Pilot

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Hi Alex, thanks for jumping on again. We thought it might be useful to quickly align after you had a chance to review the materials.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Yeah, no problem. We’ve gone through most of it internally, but it’s still a bit in-flight.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Great. Were there any major concerns or open questions we can help clarify?

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Nothing blocking per se. It’s more about prioritization and process right now.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Understood. Is that mainly on the budget side or security?

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text:
A bit of both. Security always takes longer than expected, and procurement wants to run vendor onboarding before anything moves.

InfoSec is currently backlogged, so we’re waiting on security to pick it up. And we’re still coordinating internally on who actually owns the vendor onboarding steps vs the vendor-management inbox.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Makes sense. To help us plan: is there a rough window we should work toward? Even a “late Feb vs March” type answer.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Makes sense. From our side, we’re happy to keep this lightweight and flexible.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Yeah, that helps. I just can’t commit to a concrete timeline yet. Not sure about timeline until security and procurement give us a slot.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Understood. If we send the SOC 2 + DPA + architecture diagram to vendor-management@nordbyte.io today, does that help get you unblocked on the onboarding side? And if there’s an onboarding form link we should fill out, send it over.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Would it make sense to check back in, say, in a couple of weeks? Or would you prefer we wait until InfoSec reaches the top of the queue?

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text:
Sure, that should be fine.

Also, just to flag: the business owner isn’t on this call, so I’m mostly coordinating process right now.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: In the meantime, is there anything else you’d need from us? And when you’re ready, happy to include the business owner on a short check-in.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text:
Not at the moment. If something comes up, I’ll reach out.

Procurement will handle next steps once we’re through security.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Sounds good. We’ll send over the updated docs and you can route them internally.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Thanks. We’ll get back to you once we have an update.
